description_html:
Mini Bus Driver – Licence D

Our client is looking for a reliable and responsible Mini Bus Driver holding a valid Licence D to join their team in Malta.

Key Responsibilities

  • Safely transport passengers to and from designated locations.
  • Follow assigned routes and schedules.
  • Ensure the vehicle is clean, safe, and roadworthy.
  • Carry out basic vehicle checks before and after journeys.
  • Provide a professional and courteous service to passengers.
  • Follow all road safety and company procedures.

Requirements

  • Valid Licence D.
  • Must be residing in Malta or be an EU citizen.
  • Previous experience as a bus or mini bus driver is preferred.
  • Good knowledge of Malta roads.
  • Reliable, punctual, and responsible.
  • Good communication and customer service skills.
  • Flexible to work different shifts, including weekends when required.

What is Offered

  • Full-time employment.
  • Competitive salary and employment conditions.
  • Stable working environment.
  • Training and support where required.
